text:
neuron explorer

Steering-first neuron explorer for Qwen3.5-4B. Every MLP neuron in a layer is pushed up and down on a few prompts, every
rollout is kept, and the explorer lays the results out over a 3D view of the model.

 

 Explorer

 uv sync
 uv run python explorer/server.py 

Reads sweep runs from runs/ and per-layer stats from stats/ , both produced by the sweep below; the caches in
 explorer/cache/ ship with the repo. Loads Qwen3.5-4B locally (MPS, CUDA or CPU) for live
steered chat, lens, connections and live inference over your own text.

The R and J++ lens rows read the maps of bubskee/qwen3.5-4b-r-jpp-lenses
(Apache-2.0):

 hf download bubskee/qwen3.5-4b-r-jpp-lenses --local-dir explorer/cache/rjpp

- map : the model's layers in perspective, attention and MLP per layer, one point per neuron. Hover shows a neuron's
 steer lens and R lens; click opens it; click a layer's label to view its sheet face-on. writes places
 neurons with similar down-projection columns next to each other.
- list : units ranked by word-cluster mass against random-direction controls; lens searches the steer, R and logit
 lenses for a token, fires runs your text through the model and filters neurons by activation.
- neuron : steered rollouts per prompt and dose, a three-column multi-turn steered chat (−, 0, +), lens and
 connections, a name, and where it fires on web text: its strongest FineFineWeb contexts per sign, each token shaded
 by the neuron's activation, and the domains it concentrates in.
- embeddings : UMAP of a layer's rollouts, coloured by neuron, prompt, dose or kind.
- language : the interface follows the browser language on first visit; the menu at the right of the header
 switches between English and Simplified Chinese (the choice is kept in this browser). Translations live in
 explorer/static/i18n.js .
- Claude (fourth neuron-panel tab, or the right-edge handle): a chat running the claude CLI (installed and
 logged in) with the explorer as an MCP server ( explorer/agent mcp.py ). It reads neurons, cones and lenses, runs the
 live model (steering, activations, next-token logprobs, ablations), moves the map, list and highlights, and has file
 tools and a shell in your home folder. Its prompt is explorer/agent prompt.md plus explorer/agent methodology.md , and
 explorer/agent prompt.local.md when present (untracked, for your own additions);
 EXPLORER CLAUDE MODEL picks the model. The server answers only pages and tools on this machine.

 Sweep

Runs on a CUDA 13 GPU pod with the steering fork of vLLM (RhizoNymph/vllm).

 bash sweep/setup pod.sh fork, deps, model; writes /workspace/env.sh
 python sweep/neuron stats.py --layers 22 --tokens 2000000 --out stats/q35-4b
 python sweep/steer sweep.py --stats stats/q35-4b L22.npz --design main rel --dose-unit rel \
 --neurons all --random-controls 256 --run q35-4b-L22
 sweep/run depth.sh "4 9 13 17" 384 64 random-subset sweep across several layers

 main rel doses are fractions of the median residual norm leaving the layer: {who, snake, orange} × {−0.7, +0.5, +0.8}
and {free} × {+3}, plus one unsteered baseline per prompt.

 script output 
 --- --- 
 sweep/neuron stats.py per-neuron activation extremes by sign regime, down columns, residual norms 
 sweep/steer sweep.py runs/ .jsonl : text, token ids, logprobs, top-k per step; optional activation captures 
 sweep/rank.py runs/ .units.jsonl : distinctive words, cluster mass, percentile against controls 
 sweep/steer lens.py stats/steer lens L{l}.npz : next-token Δlogprob and KL for ±0.8 pushes on every neuron 
 sweep/depth report.py runs/depth report.json : per-layer share of neurons above controls, coherence, top units 
 sweep/shift.py word-shift score against controls, all words counted 
 sweep/merge runs.py joins sharded runs of one layer 
 sweep/check equivalence.py HF vs vLLM steering and capture agreement 
 sweep/bench.py , sweep/peek.py throughput conditions; terminal views of a run 
 explorer/build embeddings.py runs/ .umap.json 
 explorer/build layout.py explorer/cache/layout writes.npz 
 explorer/build connections.py explorer/cache/connections.npz : each neuron's 24 strongest direct-path links up and down 
 sweep/fit input lens.py S.pt : the fitted input map S L (token embeddings to the residual each MLP reads, layers 0–31), RelP rules of safety-research/jpp lens; shards over prompts, merged by num prompts ; copy to explorer/cache/slens/S.pt 
 explorer/build s index.py explorer/cache/s index.npz : each neuron's top S-lens (read side) tokens, both poles 
 explorer/build rjpp index.py explorer/cache/r index.npz , jpp index.npz : each neuron's top R- and J++-lens tokens, both poles (needs the R/J++ release in explorer/cache/rjpp/ ) 
 sweep/finefineweb.py /corpus.npz , urls.json , acts.npz : a domain-balanced FineFineWeb sample (about 20M tokens over 66 domains) and every neuron's top contexts per sign and per-domain activation statistics; copy the three files to explorer/cache/ffw/ 
 sweep/capture prefill.py captures/ .mlp in.npy : MLP input at the last prompt token at the run's capture layers, steered 

 research log.md holds the findings and reasoning; NOTES.md the source notes.
